instruction: A photoreal red panda curled in a compact sitting pose, its rust-and-cream fur rendered strand-by-strand with a bushy ringed tail wrapped around tiny black paws. White facial markings and rounded ears frame dark inquisitive eyes, and subtle subsurface scattering warms the nose leather and inner ears.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Red Panda in a realistic style.
